property_summary: For any caller that is the current owner, a call to setOwner with any address argument should return true and set owner to that argument; the bug violates this by always setting owner to address(0).
change_summary: Replace 'owner = _owner;' with 'owner = address(0);' so that setOwner always sets owner to zero address instead of the argument, changing the return value from true to false when the caller is not the current owner.
